messages:
Marta: idea  launch a tiny community-labs series: 3 bite-sized tutorials + an OSS post. focus on fast first-run + a transparent benchmark appendix.
Ethan: yes. make each tutorial runnable in <15m. structure: quickstart (5m), integrate (12m), optimize (15m).
Zara: will draft the OSS post with a contributor checklist and migration notes for folks coming from other runtimes. keep legal/licensing blurb short.
Kai: I can run perf sweeps: tokens/sec, p50 latency, and est $/1k tokens for baseline vs q8/q4. will publish CSV in repo.
Marta: marketing assets: 2 hero images, a 60s demo clip, and a 3-tweet thread. keep copy dev-focused and direct.
Ethan: include a small benchmark callout on the landing: "~X% lower cost with batching + quant" but keep numbers conservative and rounded.
Zara: closed beta? suggest invite 10 active community devs, collect quick feedback and 2-3 quotes for the post.
Kai: infra booked Tue-Thu next week. I'll tag runs with model+quant settings and upload logs to the repo.
Marta: ops-bot  schedule a 25m kickoff Mon 9:30 and add a checklist card in the board. also add an AB-test task: headline A = Start in 5, B = See inference savings.
ops-bot: created event "community-labs kickoff" Mon 09:30  invites sent to Marta, Ethan, Zara, Kai. board: https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/community-labs/board. tasks added: draft outlines, perf CSV, design assets, closed beta invites, AB-test setup.
Ethan: I'll prepare both landing headlines and a short telemetry plan: signups, time-to-first-run, and demo completions.
Zara: I'll include an eval harness and an "expected outputs" file to detect regressions. publish everything to the repo with a README and CSV appendix.
Marta: perfect. next check Mon. keep content tight and dev-first. :rocket:
